# Detroit Web Agency & M2 Training

> Detroit Web Agency builds websites, CRMs, and lead-gen automation for contractors and local service businesses in metro Detroit. M2 Training delivers strength, conditioning, and youth athlete coaching from Grosse Pointe, MI.

This project is multi-tenant: detroitwebagent.com serves Detroit Web Agency (B2B automation/SaaS) and mattmichelstraining.com serves M2 Training (fitness coaching). Content varies by hostname.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page (M2 Training fitness brand on M2 host, DWA on DWA host).
- [About](/about): Matt Michels — coach, founder, 20+ years training youth athletes.
- [Pricing](/pricing): M2 training plans and DWA product pricing.
- [Agency](/agency): Detroit Web Agency overview.
- [All Services](/all-services): Full DWA product catalog.
- [Free Tools](/free-tools): Free SEO + breach scanners and AI generators.
- [Free Site Scanner](/free-site-scanner): Audit any website for SEO/perf issues.
- [Detroit Web Design](/detroit-web-design): Web design for Detroit-area businesses.
- [FieldDesk](/field-service): Field-service CRM for contractors ($199/mo).
- [TechAlert](/talent-radar): Hiring intel & candidate alerts ($79–149/mo).
- [SiteRadar](/site-radar): Anonymous website visitor identification ($49/mo).
- [Contractor Leads](/contractor-leads): Permit-driven lead generation ($399/mo).
- [Mortgage Radar](/mortgage-radar): Loan officer lead intel ($149/mo).
- [Missed-Call Catch](/missed-call-setup): Auto-text missed callers back ($99/mo).
- [Dead Lead Reactivation](/dead-lead-intake): Win back stale leads ($50/reply).
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Pay-per-lead contractor marketplace.
- [Bundle Revenue Suite](/bundle-revenue-suite): All DWA products bundled.

## Optional
